basis: pages = sum over volumes of ceil(highest <pc> column / 2) = 4750; lines = body lines of the machine text, NOT printed lines
note: 8171 distinct <pc> page-col codes (odd = left column, even = right, per pwg-meta2.txt). edition: Oxford English Dictionary, corrected re-issue 1933 of OED1 1928, vol. IV (F-G)
basis: random sample of 3 printed pages (78, 362, 154); lines counted by row projection on the page image; chars/column from the page's own OCR text layer between its two running heads
note: Page size derived from the scan's declared 600 dpi and its original pixel dimensions, not from a caliper. Entries are a visual count on the page image (+/-1).
